notes: Researched from public citi.com pages only (no sign-in). The mock bill is a Citi Personal Loan. Citi publishes: no late fees, no prepayment penalty, no origination fees; a 0.25% APR discount only for enrolling in automatic payments at origination; automatic payments are monthly withdrawals from a qualifying checking, savings or money market account; one-time payments in any amount must satisfy the monthly statement balance; principal-only payments are not allowed (not enforceable in the engine). Loan servicing phone 1-800-685-0935. Online statements and Online Bill Payment pages render only client-side (text not retrievable), so statement retention and bill-pay details come from the catalog record (24 months) and are kept out of help text. Sign-on page (citi.com/login) shows User ID, Password, Remember me, Sign On, Register / Activate, Forgot User ID or Password, plus passwordless QR sign-on through the Citi Mobile app; MFA channel not documented on fetched U.S. pages, kept at sms (inferred). Guest pay not found (inferred). Late fee set to $0 per the published no-late-fee policy. Reviewed 2026-10-09: register label corrected to Register / Activate and sign-on help added from the public sign-on page; fee, autopay-discount, principal-only and default-APR facts re-verified on citi.com/personal-loans. guest_pay.note: Personal loan payments are made after signing on to Citi Online, or by calling Personal Loans Services at 1-800-685-0935.

help.title: Paying your Citi Personal Loan
paragraphs: Sign on to Citi Online to make a one-time payment from a checking, savings or money market account. A one-time payment can be any amount, as long as it covers your monthly statement balance.
Citi does not currently accept principal-only payments, but you can pay off the loan early at any time with no prepayment penalty.
Questions about your loan? Call Personal Loans Services and Support at 1-800-685-0935 (TTY 711).

help.title: Automatic personal loan payments
paragraphs: Automatic payments are monthly withdrawals of your loan payment from a qualifying checking, savings or money market account.
Borrowers who enroll in automatic payments when the loan is originated get a 0.25% APR discount.

help.title: Personal loan fees
paragraphs: Citi charges no late fees, no prepayment penalty and no origination fees on its personal loans.
If the loan goes into default, the APR may increase by 2.00%.

help.title: Contact Citi Personal Loans
paragraphs: Call Personal Loans Services and Support at 1-800-685-0935 (TTY 711 or another relay service) for help with payments, refinancing or changes to your loan.

help.title: Signing on to Citi Online
paragraphs: Sign on with your User ID and password. New to online access? Choose Register / Activate. Locked out? Use Forgot User ID or Password.
Passwordless sign-on: scan the QR code on the sign-on page with your phone camera or the Citi Mobile app. It works for customers enrolled in Face ID, Touch ID, biometrics or a 6-digit PIN.
